title: 90s Arcade Neobrutalist UI Redesign
description:
Complete UI overhaul implementing 90s video game aesthetic with neobrutalist design principles. See docs/DESIGN_SPEC_90s_NEOBRUTALIST.md for full spec.

Key changes:
- Arcade color palette (electric cyan, hot pink, toxic green)
- Lucide React icons replacing all emojis
- 4px black borders, hard offset shadows
- Archivo Black / Inter / JetBrains Mono typography
- Snappy 100-150ms transitions

Convoy work: 4 phases, 14 work items

title: Phase 1: Socket Infrastructure
description:
---
keeper: ADR-002
constraints: [server-auth, event-reuse, type-safe]
---
Create SocketContext and GameStateContext for socket.io connection.

Tasks:
1. Create packages/client/src/context/SocketContext.tsx
   - Typed socket.io connection provider
   - Auto-connect on mount, handle reconnection
   - Expose socket instance and isConnected state

2. Create packages/client/src/context/GameStateContext.tsx
   - Manage room, players, game phase, local player state
   - Listen to socket events and update state
   - Provide actions: createRoom, joinRoom, leaveRoom, startGame, etc.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Use only socket events from backend seeds (no new events)
- Server-authoritative: context is view-layer cache
- Use types from @heyhey/shared

Reference: docs/SPEC_WIRE_UP_APP.md Phase 1
Keeper ADR: heyhey/keeper/decisions/002-wire-up-app.yaml
